subject: reasoning
question:
A, B, C, D, G, H, and I are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Only two people sit between A and H when counted from the right of A. Only two people sit between H and D. Only three people sit between A and B. C sits to the immediate left of I.

Who sits third to the left of G?
solution:
**Given: ** A, B, C, D, G, H, and I are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Only two people sit between A and H when counted from the right of A. Only two people sit between H and D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69f8dbb16d9a97494a5d200c15e7bd595ef1e4daa4cc2b7b4712991a34474425.png] 

Only two people sit between H and D. Only three people sit between A and B. C sits to the immediate left of I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a4ac1542bf386b589c742c31f332b097c52d214307241732f2cf2bb44639924.png] 

Thus, I sits third to the left of G.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
